description: Send Hermoso renders to the user's Canva: each is uploaded to their Canva uploads, ready to drag into any design. asDesign:true also asks Canva AI to rebuild a PNG, JPEG or WEBP image as a new design whose text, objects and background are separate editable layers: it uses the account's Canva credits and can redraw details, so only when the user asks for an editable design. Pass Library ids (L0… from list_library), Hermoso render links, or any public https image/video link (upload_file turns a local file into one); optional title, folderId (list_canva_folder / create_canva_folder), asDesign:false for the upload only. Answers with each upload, and each design's edit link. Free on Hermoso. Needs Canva connected (Settings > Connectors > Canva).

asDesign.description: true asks Canva AI to rebuild an image as an editable layered design (uses Canva credits); default false: the upload only

folderId.description: Canva folder id from list_canva_folder or create_canva_folder; omit for the default folder

title.description: title for the new Canva design or upload

urls.description: render links or any public https image/video link

name: save_to_canva
title: Save to Canva
